name: watersplash-imagemasking
blurb: Images masked by a water splash shape using CSS mask-image.
description: Applies CSS mask-image property to show images through an SVG splash silhouette. Scales and centers to cover the container.
use_when: Creating organic, nature-inspired image frames without layout shift.
avoid_when: Browsers without mask-image support; older Safari versions have inconsistent behavior.
a11y: Images must have alt text; CSS mask is decorative and invisible to assistive tech.
